title: Purchaser's receipt entries on its copy of a DEA Form 222
rule_summary: The purchaser must record on its copy of the DEA Form 222 the number of commercial or bulk containers furnished on each item and the dates on which the containers are received by the purchaser.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate knows that the paper route carries its own receipt-recording duty on the purchaser's retained copy.
common_confusions: The entries the supplier makes on the original under 21 CFR 1305.13(b) are a different duty from the entries the purchaser makes on its copy.
verification_notes: Read in the current eCFR text of 21 CFR 1305.13(e) on ecfr.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
